recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist mid-century album layout featuring a large off-white field, centered cyan-blue typography, and a small, rounded-corner photographic portrait positioned in the lower half.
coreVisualRelationships: Large negative space framing a central vertical axis
Cyan blue type contrasting against a warm off-white ground
Rounded rectangular photo frame echoing the soft curves of the typography
Hierarchical text stack decreasing in size from top to bottom
coreInvariants: Cyan blue as the primary typographic color
Rounded corners on the central image frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic portrait is centered in the lower third, occupying approximately 25% of the total vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan artist name in the upper-center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan: Title -> Artist Name -> Tracklist -> Portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive margins on all sides create a sense of breathability and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with medium-saturation cyan; portrait contains deep blacks and muted blues.
paletteRestrictions: No vibrant reds or yellows in the graphic elements

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif and wide sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the sans-serif sections
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extended Slab Serif for impact paired with Extended Sans-Serif for informational clarity.
graphicDevices: Small star glyphs used as track separators

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab serif structure and extended proportions of the main title.
Captures the mid-century sans-serif aesthetic of the tracklist.
Alternative for the wide sans-serif feel common in 1960s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an off-white, slightly textured paper background. In the lower center, place a portrait of a person in a rounded-corner rectangular frame. The portrait should have a cool-toned, slightly grainy 1960s film aesthetic with deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a cyan blue color, typeset the main title in a large extended slab-serif font at the top center. Below it, typeset secondary text in a smaller extended sans-serif font, centered. Add small black metadata text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background off-white rather than pure white?
Are all text blocks perfectly centered horizontally?
Does the photo frame have significantly rounded corners?
Is the primary text color a consistent cyan blue?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the photo frame
Amount of paper texture in the background
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
The exact face in the portrait
postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serif is sufficiently 'extended' in width.
Ensure the photo does not touch the edges of the canvas.
Verify the star separators are present in the tracklist block.
Confirm the cyan color is vibrant but not neon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Off-white field + Centered Cyan Extended Typography + Rounded Photo Inset = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic.
